mapper.select: SELECT status, COUNT(*) c FROM sn_item WHERE status IN ('PENDING_ALLOC','TO_PUSH','ALLOCATED') GROUP BY status
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sn_item WHERE status IN ('PENDING_ALLOC','TO_PUSH','ALLOCATED') AND suspend IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sn_delivery_batch WHERE (result = 'FAILED' OR (result = 'UNCONFIRMED' AND push_state = 'EXHAUSTED'))
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sn_delivery_batch WHERE result = 'UNCONFIRMED' AND source = 'PULL' AND created_at < #{cutoff}
SELECT alert_type, COUNT(*) n FROM sn_delivery_alert WHERE status = 'OPEN' GROUP BY alert_type
SELECT action, SUM(qty) q FROM sn_audit WHERE created_at >= #{start} AND result = 'OK' AND action IN ('SN_GENERATE','SN_ALLOCATE','SN_PULL','TRANSFER_BILL') GROUP BY action
SELECT confirm_method, SUM(qty) q FROM sn_delivery_batch WHERE batch_type <> 'TRANSFER_OUT' AND confirmed_at >= #{start} GROUP BY confirm_method
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sn_gen_job WHERE status = 'RUNNING'
SELECT plan_json FROM sn_gen_job WHERE status = 'RUNNING'
SELECT gen_batch, pi_no, qty, done_qty, status, error_msg, created_by, created_at, plan_json FROM sn_gen_job ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT * FROM sn_delivery_batch WHERE (result = 'FAILED' OR (result = 'UNCONFIRMED' AND (push_state = 'EXHAUSTED' OR (source = 'PULL' AND created_at < #{cutoff})))) ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT * FROM sn_delivery_alert WHERE status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20
